sources.title: Piracy monthly report May 2023
sources.text: Four robbers armed with a knife, boarded a ship underway. They took hostage and tied the duty crew, stole personal properties and ship’s engine spares. Alert crew raised the alarm and crew mustered. Hearing the alarm, the robbers escaped with stolen ship’s engine spare parts and personal properties. Incident reported to local authority.
